commands.stdin_python:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from src import export_quantize as ex
from src.coco_split import coco_inputs, load_config
from src.parity_gate import parity_contract
config = load_config()
_, images, partitions = coco_inputs(config)
config["resolutions"] = [320]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
    ex.model_path = lambda size, backend: Path(temp) / f"{backend}_{size}.onnx"
    for backend in ("onnx_fp32", "onnx_fp16", "onnx_int8"):
        args = (320, backend, partitions["calib_200"], images, config)
        model = ex.export_variant(*args)
        stamp = model.with_suffix(".provenance.json")
        before = (model.stat().st_mtime_ns, stamp.stat().st_mtime_ns)
        assert ex.export_variant(*args) == model
        assert (model.stat().st_mtime_ns, stamp.stat().st_mtime_ns) == before
        print(f"PASS actual {backend} export and unchanged-cache reuse", flush=True)
    fingerprint = parity_contract(config, partitions, images)
    assert len(fingerprint["fast_images"]) == 1000
    assert fingerprint["fp32_sha256"]["320"] == ex.digest(ex.model_path(320, "onnx_fp32"))
    print("PASS real checkpoint, exported file and 1,000 ordered image fingerprints", flush=True)
